findings.impact: Accepted history can reach a state that cannot be checkpointed; at receipt capacity Archive and writer recovery are also denied. Current-tail fork and compaction require a successful sealed checkpoint and cannot recover this unsealed state.
findings.next_revision: Reserve receipt slots and worst-case retained bytes for checkpoint, archive, and fresh writer recovery before accepting append traffic. Compaction retains identity digests and complete mutation receipts, so it cannot recover receipt capacity. Preserve current raw-request deduplication and require fresh approved admissions after restart.

findings.trigger: For Snapshot(session, after=1, limit=1), supply a success reply with tail=0, floor=1, empty checkpoint and empty events, correct request ID and request SHA.
findings.impact: Public Reply construction and decode_for accept a successful over-tail cursor reply even though the host and documented contract require Conflict. A client cannot rely on the SDK to reject this impossible recovery response.
findings.next_revision: Require request.after <= reply.info.tail before accepting a successful Snapshot in validate_for; reject this response in both typed construction and raw consumer decoding.

findings.title: Accepted partial execution observations cannot advance when later exit/output-closure facts arrive
findings.scenario: Trusted callback returns exit_code=Some(0), output_closed=false. An exact Report is accepted as Reported. After the output stream really closes, a complete Report returns Conflict, execute_claimed returns Denied without invoking a callback, and inspect_tool_observation continues to return the original partial facts.
findings.observed: Confirmed with real original Core Store; partial state and complete state are distinguished correctly but there is no progression interface.
findings.safety: This is an availability/completeness gap, not unauthorized execution. Callback replay remains blocked.
findings.suggested_followup: Add a separately reviewed trusted host observation progression/reconciliation path. Keep the one-shot invocation marker intact and require monotonic independently validated exit/output-close observations; do not use callback replay to obtain later facts.
findings.contract_status: R1 documentation explicitly permits partial Reported observations. The repro does not show a frozen-contract violation; it demonstrates that the basic lifecycle lacks a subsequent observation progression interface.

findings.title: A callback error after an effect leaves no trusted late-observation recording path
findings.scenario: Trusted callback performs a real file-write effect and then returns Error::Storage. SDK returns CommitUnknown, records no observed_facts, rejects a subsequently recovered factual Report with Conflict, and permanently prevents callback reentry.
findings.observed: Confirmed: effect exists, observations None, phase DispatchUnknown, late Report Conflict, callback reentry count zero.
findings.safety: Unknown and no replay are correct. The missing interface is factual reconciliation, not permission to retry the effect.
findings.suggested_followup: Provide a trusted host-only way to retain independently recovered facts for an existing Unknown operation without issuing a permit, claim, callback, or renewed execution authority.
findings.contract_status: R1 intentionally retains Unknown after a callback error and forbids replay. The missing capability is trusted late factual reconciliation, not a violation of the no-replay contract.

findings.title: Revoked/expired admission history consumes all 128 lifetime slots
findings.scenario: After 128 cumulative admissions, the next admission returns Limit even after all earlier admissions were revoked or have expired.
findings.safety: All invalid admissions still fail closed; this prevents long-lived host operation.
findings.suggested_followup: Reclaim inactive entries without reviving or reusing their nonces; preserve exact connection/issuer/lifetime checks.

findings.title: Trusted host cannot finalize an unconsumed tool after its original proposer disappears
findings.scenario: Tool is Approved. Revoke or disconnect original proposer; trusted revoke_tool returns Denied while a valid current reader still sees Approved.
findings.safety: Claim/execution are already denied by live proposer checks. Consumed Unknown must never be relabeled as proof of no execution.
findings.suggested_followup: Allow an independently authorized trusted host to terminate unconsumed Proposed/Approved state without requiring the expired/revoked proposer; retain consumed Unknown history.
